## About
Somerset Animal Clinic is a full service animal hospital located south of San Antonio in Somerset, Texas. We're proud to serve the Somerset community and their furry friends, from wellness exams and immunizations to surgery, dental work, boarding and baths.
Our office is just off the 1604 Highway, so chances are good we're on your way. Our neighbors have given us a 4.7 rating from 320 Google reviews, and we'd love to meet your pet too.

## Services
- Heartworm & Intestinal Parasite Testing: Testing, prevention and treatment, with heartworm prevention like Trifexis, Heartgard and Revolution for Cats.
- Dental Services: Dental care under anesthesia, with extractions when your pet needs them.
- Digital X-Ray: Abdominal, chest and orthopedic digital X-rays, plus in-house lab work.
- Free Microchip Scanning: We also offer microchip identification and implantation.
- Online pharmacy: Order your pet's medications online and have them delivered to your door.
- Boarding: Kennels are available when you need someone to look after your pet. Call us to set up a stay.
- Bathing: A deep cleaning bath, blow dry, nail trim and ear cleaning come standard on every bath. By appointment only.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, and we're not open on Sunday. Give us a call if you're not sure we're in.

Q: What should I do in an emergency?
A: Please call the clinic.

Q: How much does boarding cost?
A: Boarding is charged by your pet's weight and how long they stay. Give us a call and we can tell you more.

Q: Does my pet need anything before a bath?
A: Baths are by appointment only, and your pet must be current on rabies.

Q: Do you carry flea and tick products?
A: Yes. We carry over the counter products like Advantage, Frontline Gold and Seresto collars, and prescription prevention like Nexgard, Comfortis and Revolution.
